summary: Nokia Corporation filed a Form 6-K on July 29, 2026, disclosing routine Managers' Transactions under Article 19 of the EU Market Abuse Regulation. Two senior managers, Kristen Pressner and Mikko Hautala, each acquired shares on the same date at EUR 7.8402 per share on XHEL. Pressner acquired 66,324 shares, Hautala 7,103 shares. This is a standard insider transaction notification, not a special-situation event. No M&A, restructuring, activist, or other special-situations category applies. The filing is merely a regulatory disclosure of open-market purchases by executives.
